description: Read the raw content of a specific file or directory tree from a repository at a designated branch, tag, or commit ref. Use when inspecting current repository source code or configs. Do NOT use for reviewing diffs between branches (use 'get_merge_request_changes') or viewing commit diffs (use 'get_commit').

end_line.description: Optional 1-based end line to slice content

file_path.description: Path to the file or directory in repo (e.g. 'pom.xml', 'docs/README.md', or 'src' for directory tree)

outline_only.description: When true, extract and return only high-level symbol declarations (classes, functions, interfaces, methods, types) with their line numbers instead of full content (default: false)

project_id.description: Project numeric ID (e.g. 31) or namespace path (e.g. 'group/project-name'). URL-encoding is handled automatically.

ref.description: Branch name, tag, or commit SHA (default: default branch / HEAD)

start_line.description: Optional 1-based start line to slice content

name: get_file_contents
title: Get File Contents
